aboutGame.title: What is Terrible Lizards Wiki?
paragraphs: Terrible Lizards is a first-person horror parkour game from developer WDR Studios LLC, published by Digital Pajamas and Behaviour Interactive. It strands you in 1992 at Dalton's Dinos, a fading Route 66 roadside attraction in New Mexico where the staff have vanished, a telephone keeps ringing about a missing child, and something is hunting you between the fiberglass dinosaurs.

There are no weapons and no combat, so your only tools are speed, momentum, and route knowledge. Terrible Lizards Wiki gathers the movement fundamentals, creature behavior, story clues, demo details, and release information you need to chain vaults, wall runs, and slides into a clean escape instead of another restart.

modules.name: Terrible Lizards Wiki Beginner Guide
modules.description: A beginner-focused guide covering the core gameplay loop, survival basics, movement mechanics, and how to approach the horror parkour challenges at Dalton's Dinos.

highlights.detail: Walk the perimeter of a new zone before touching anything that makes noise
Stop and listen for 10 to 15 seconds on arrival to check for nearby creatures
Identify two climbable structures so a chase always has a fallback
Test one jump or vault early to confirm what the geometry actually allows
Note objective markers so you never wander into a dead end
Keep moving, but never sprint without a reason and save stamina for escapes

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about Terrible Lizards Wiki and the game it covers.

items.question: What is Terrible Lizards?
items.answer: Terrible Lizards is a first-person horror parkour game from WDR Studios LLC, published by Digital Pajamas and Behaviour Interactive. Terrible Lizards Wiki covers its 1992 Dalton's Dinos setting, where you are hunted by dinosaurs and cannot fight back.

items.question: Is there any combat in Terrible Lizards?
items.answer: No. The game has no weapons and combat is not an option, so every encounter is solved with movement, stealth, and breaking line of sight. Terrible Lizards Wiki breaks those escapes down route by route.

items.question: When does Terrible Lizards release, and is there a demo?
items.answer: The full game launches on October 29, 2026 for PC, PS5, and Xbox. A playable demo has been available since September 24, 2026, and Terrible Lizards Wiki explains how to use it to practice parkour routes early.

items.question: Can you play Terrible Lizards in co-op?
items.answer: No. Terrible Lizards Wiki covers a strictly single-player experience, with no co-op or multiplayer mode listed on any store page.

items.question: Where should beginners start on Terrible Lizards Wiki?
items.answer: Begin with the Terrible Lizards Wiki beginner guide and controls guide, learn the six parkour moves, then walk the perimeter of each new zone before you sprint through it.
